action_or_input: Employee A selects Send/Forward on the active file, provides a mandatory movement comment, and designates Employee B as recipient.
expected_result: File state transitions to Active/Circulated held by Employee B. Movement history, audit log updated with sender details, receiver details, timestamp, and comment. Notification event triggered for Employee B.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists held by Institute Employee A (authorized sender). Institute Employee B is a valid recipient. File is not archived.
purpose: Verify that an authorized current holder can forward an active file to a valid recipient with a mandatory comment, resulting in the file being held by the recipient.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to forward the file without entering a movement comment.
expected_result: Forward action is rejected. File state remains unchanged. No movement history or audit entry created for this action. No notification triggered.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists held by an authorized Institute Employee. A valid recipient is designated.
purpose: Verify that forwarding is rejected when no mandatory movement comment is provided.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to forward the archived file with a mandatory comment and a valid recipient.
expected_result: Forward action is rejected. File remains in Archived/Read-only state. No new movement record created.
preconditions: A file exists in Archived state. Institute Employee is associated with the file.
purpose: Verify that forwarding is rejected when the file is already archived.

action_or_input: Employee C attempts to forward the file with a mandatory comment and a valid recipient.
expected_result: Forward action is rejected due to insufficient authorization. File state unchanged. No movement or audit entry created.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists. Institute Employee C is not an authorized holder of the file.
purpose: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot forward a file.

action_or_input: Employee B selects Forward on the received active file, provides a mandatory movement comment, and designates Employee C as next recipient.
expected_result: File state transitions to Active/Circulated held by Employee C. Movement/history/audit updated. Notification event triggered for Employee C.
preconditions: An active/circulated file is held by Institute Employee B (who received it from Employee A). Employee C is a valid next recipient. File is not archived.
purpose: Verify that a current holder of an active circulated file can forward it onward to a next recipient with a mandatory comment, completing one loop traversal.

action_or_input: Current holder attempts to forward the file onward without providing a movement comment.
expected_result: Onward forward action rejected. File state unchanged. No movement history entry or audit record created.
preconditions: An active/circulated file is held by an authorized current recipient. A valid next recipient is selected.
purpose: Verify that onward forwarding is rejected when mandatory movement comment is absent.

action_or_input: Employee B selects Return, provides a mandatory movement comment, and confirms return to Employee A.
expected_result: File state transitions to Active/Circulated held by Employee A. Return action recorded in movement history with sender details, receiver details, timestamp, and comment. Return notification event triggered for Employee A.
preconditions: An active/circulated file is held by Institute Employee B. Previous sender Employee A is known. File is not archived.
purpose: Verify that an authorized current recipient can return an active file to the previous sender with a mandatory comment.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to return the file without entering a movement comment.
expected_result: Return action rejected. File state remains unchanged. No return movement record or audit entry created. No notification triggered.
preconditions: An active/circulated file is held by an authorized current recipient. Previous sender is known.
purpose: Verify that the return action is rejected when no mandatory movement comment is provided.

action_or_input: Employee D attempts to return the file with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: Return action rejected due to insufficient authorization. File state unchanged.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists. Institute Employee D is not the current authorized recipient.
purpose: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot return a file.

action_or_input: File owner selects Archive on the active file.
expected_result: File transitions to Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained state. Archive action recorded in audit log. Archive notification event triggered for associated employees. File cannot be modified or forwarded further.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists. The requesting Institute Employee is the file owner. File is not already archived. Intended collaborative objective is complete.
purpose: Verify that the file owner can archive a completed active/circulated file, closing the lifecycle.

action_or_input: Employee B attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: Archive action rejected. File state remains Active/Circulated. No archive audit entry created.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists. Institute Employee B is not the file owner.
purpose: Verify that a non-owner cannot archive a file.

action_or_input: File owner attempts to archive the already-archived file.
expected_result: Archive action rejected. File remains in Archived state. No duplicate audit entry created.
preconditions: A file already in Archived state exists. The requesting employee is the file owner.
purpose: Verify that archiving an already-archived file is rejected.

action_or_input: An associated authorized employee attempts to forward or add a comment to the archived file.
expected_result: Modification and forwarding actions are rejected. File remains in Archived/Read-only state.
preconditions: A file is in Archived/Read-only state.
purpose: Verify that an archived file cannot be forwarded or modified.

action_or_input: Employee creates a new file with a mandatory initial comment (and optional attachments), saves as draft, then immediately forwards it to a recipient with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: State transitions: (No record) → Draft/Pre-circulation → Active/Circulated held by Recipient. File creation and forwarding are recorded in movement history and audit log. Notification triggered for recipient.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record for this new file. Institute Employee (Creator/Sender) is authorized. A valid recipient exists.
purpose: Verify that a new file can be created with a mandatory initial comment, saved as draft, and immediately forwarded to a recipient with a mandatory movement comment without any draft edit.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to create a new file without providing the mandatory initial comment.
expected_result: File creation rejected. No Draft file record created. No audit entry for creation.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee initiates new file creation.
purpose: Verify that file creation is rejected when the mandatory initial comment is absent.

action_or_input: Employee creates a new file with a mandatory initial comment and one or more optional attachments.
expected_result: Draft file record created with the initial comment and attachments. Attachments recorded in audit/history. File saved as Draft/Pre-circulation.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee initiates new file creation.
purpose: Verify that optional attachments can be added during file creation and are recorded.

action_or_input: Step 1 – Employee creates a new file with a mandatory initial comment (Draft created). Step 2 – Employee opens the draft and edits it (one edit traversal). Step 3 – Employee forwards the updated draft to a recipient with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: State transitions: (No record) → Draft → Updated Draft → Active/Circulated held by Recipient. All three transitions are recorded. Notification triggered for recipient.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee has a saved Draft/Pre-circulation file. A valid recipient exists.
purpose: Verify the full path: create draft, edit once, then forward to recipient.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to use the draft-edit function on the active/circulated file.
expected_result: Edit action rejected or unavailable. Active/Circulated file state unchanged.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists (not a draft).
purpose: Verify that draft edit is only possible when file is in Draft/Pre-circulation state.

action_or_input: Employee creates a new file with a mandatory initial comment (Draft created). Employee immediately selects Discard on the draft without editing.
expected_result: State transitions: (No record) → Draft → Discarded/No active file retained. No active file remains. Discard recorded. File cannot be forwarded or archived.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee has just created a Draft/Pre-circulation file.
purpose: Verify that a draft created with zero edit traversals can be discarded before submission.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to discard the active/circulated file.
expected_result: Discard action rejected or unavailable. Active/Circulated file state unchanged.
preconditions: An active/circulated file exists (already submitted and circulated).
purpose: Verify that discard is only available for draft files and not for circulated files.

action_or_input: Step 1 – Employee creates a new file with a mandatory initial comment (Draft created). Step 2 – Employee edits the draft once (Updated Draft). Step 3 – Employee selects Discard on the updated draft.
expected_result: State transitions: (No record) → Draft → Updated Draft → Discarded/No active file retained. No active file remains. Discarded state recorded.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee has a saved Draft/Pre-circulation file.
purpose: Verify that a draft can be edited once and then discarded before circulation.

action_or_input: Step 1 – Employee A forwards to Employee B with mandatory comment. Step 2 – Employee B forwards to Employee C with mandatory comment. Step 3 – Employee A (file owner) archives the file.
expected_result: After Step 1: File held by B, movement history updated, notification to B. After Step 2: File held by C, movement history updated, notification to C. After Step 3: File Archived/Read-only, archive audit recorded, archive notification triggered.
preconditions: An active file is held by Employee A (sender). Employee B and Employee C are valid recipients. Employee A is the file owner.
purpose: Verify the composite collaborative lifecycle: initial forward (BW-FTS-01) → onward forward (BW-FTS-02) → archive (BW-FTS-04).

action_or_input: Step 1 – Employee A forwards to Employee B with mandatory comment. Step 2 – Employee B returns to Employee A with mandatory comment. Step 3 – Employee A (file owner) archives the file.
expected_result: After Step 1: File held by B, movement history updated. After Step 2: File held by A, return recorded, return notification triggered. After Step 3: File Archived/Read-only, archive audit recorded.
preconditions: An active file is held by Employee A (sender/file owner). Employee B is a valid recipient.
purpose: Verify the composite collaborative lifecycle: initial forward (BW-FTS-01) → return (BW-FTS-03) → archive (BW-FTS-04).

action_or_input: Step 1 – Employee A forwards to Employee B. Step 2 – Employee B forwards to Employee C. Step 3 – Employee C returns to Employee B. Step 4 – Employee A archives the file.
expected_result: Each transition updates movement history and triggers required notifications. After Step 4 file is Archived/Read-only. Audit log reflects all four transitions chronologically.
preconditions: An active file is held by Employee A (sender/file owner). Employees B and C are valid recipients.
purpose: Verify the composite path: initial forward → onward forward → return after onward traversal → archive.

action_or_input: Creator makes a new file with mandatory initial comment, then immediately forwards to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: State: (No record) → Draft → Active/Circulated held by Recipient. Full creation-to-circulation audit chain recorded. Notification triggered.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee (Creator/Sender) and a valid recipient exist.
purpose: Verify the composite new-file path: create → circulate immediately (BW-FTS-05 integrated via CW-FTS-02).

action_or_input: Creator makes a new file with mandatory initial comment (Draft), edits the draft once (Updated Draft), then forwards to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: State: (No record) → Draft → Updated Draft → Active/Circulated held by Recipient. All transitions recorded in audit. Notification triggered.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee (Creator/Sender) and a valid recipient exist.
purpose: Verify the composite new-file path: create → edit draft once → circulate (BW-FTS-06 integrated via CW-FTS-02).

action_or_input: Creator makes a new file with mandatory initial comment (Draft), then immediately selects Discard without editing.
expected_result: State: (No record) → Draft → Discarded. No active file remains. Discard recorded. No notification for forwarding/archiving triggered.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee initiates new file creation.
purpose: Verify the composite new-file path: create → discard immediately with no prior edit (BW-FTS-07 integrated via CW-FTS-02).

action_or_input: Creator makes a new file with mandatory initial comment (Draft), edits the draft once (Updated Draft), then selects Discard.
expected_result: State: (No record) → Draft → Updated Draft → Discarded. No active file remains. All transitions recorded. No forwarding or archiving notification triggered.
preconditions: No existing FTS file record. Authorized employee initiates new file creation.
purpose: Verify the composite new-file path: create → edit draft once → discard (BW-FTS-08 integrated via CW-FTS-02).
